segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I saw your note about expanding the analytics workspace from 48 to 65 seats before the finance team go-live on May 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We have 12 folks in FP&A and 5 in accounting who need access. Same permission level as the current managers, nothing custom.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. At your current tier, the additional 17 seats would be $38 per seat per month, co-termed to your renewal on November 30. That comes out to $4,262 for the remaining term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. Can we keep it on the same invoice as the main subscription? Our AP team doesn't want a separate vendor line if we can avoid it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, same billing account and same PO. The billing tool will add it as a prorated line item on the April invoice, due net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. And just confirming, if we sign by Friday, the seats can be active by Monday the 22nd?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Once the order form is signed, provisioning is usually same day. I'd say Monday is safe, and your admin can assign the seats from the workspace settings.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If the amount is $4,262, I can approve it without a legal review.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it over this afternoon with the co-term dates and seat count noted clearly.
